requirements.description: All active requirement sources are versioned and reconciled without silent deletion
Canonical product authorities remain unique and no parallel Viewer/Project/BOM engines are introduced
IFC geometry uses a bounded persistent process worker pool with recovery and clean shutdown
Geometry priority is dynamic, viewport-aware, hysteretic and starvation-safe
MeshCache V2 persists complete mesh payloads atomically and rejects corruption
Scene uploads are generation-safe and bounded by per-frame time budgets
ViewerPerformanceGovernor controls interaction, recovery and idle rendering quality including MSAA
Packaged cold, warm and same-session metrics include first usable, exact milestones, p95/p99 and memory/process counts
A real ten-minute OpenGL Viewer soak proves bounded actors, workers and memory
Viewer interaction, selection, visibility, section, measurement and saved-view behavior remains functional
Unified intake handles IFC, STEP, NC1, Trusted PDF, External PDF and project packages fail-closed
Project state and user preferences are versioned, separated and recover safely
The exact primary navigation is Project, Viewer, Productie, Controle, Uitvoer
V5.2 design system is light-first with a dark preference smoke path and yellow whole-object selection
Owned controls use stable ui_test_id identity and central control/icon registries
BOM is the immutable quantity truth with exact reconciliation and full traceability
BOM and Machines joins production state through canonical IDs
Machine routing has one versioned AUTO/MANUAL assignment authority
Invalid machine overrides remain REVIEW/BLOCKED and never authorize transfer
Machine library validates ranges, tools, operations, priorities and active state
Workbench remains the single transactional write path with rollback and undo/redo
Canonical rebuild and roundtrip invalidate stale derivatives
Manufacturing Geometry Interpreter V3 full V2 gap closure with independent compound proof
Interpreter exact READY requires two-way BREP proof and false READY remains zero
Existing faces, contact, scribing, identification, capability and neutral-job chain remains authoritative
Profile nesting preserves machine/tool/stock/remnant constraints and deterministic proof
Plate nesting supports polygon geometry, holes, grain, rotations, remnants, locks and exact validation
Converter capability registry blocks every feature not proven by serializer and reimport comparator
Productie screens and controls operate on the same canonical project and selection
Routing, nesting and production state survive save and reopen
One production drawing engine emits vector geometry, dimensions, annotations and title blocks
Production drawing PDF remains sharp at 800 percent and is not a full-page raster
Drawing linter blocks incomplete, stale, clipped or raster-only production pages
Trusted PDF payload and hash verification fails closed on tamper
External PDF remains evidence/confidence gated and REVIEW_REQUIRED until proven
One DocumentOutputService owns preview, print and batch output
Ctrl+P opens the context Print Center and printer failure is fail-closed
Controle exposes validation, compare, manufacturability, geometry, evidence and PDF review
Problem Center reports blockers, errors and warnings without false green
Quality inspection supports plans, measurements, NCR, rework, reinspection and release blocking
Planning owns resources, work centers, shifts, requirements, orders and scheduled operations
Finite-capacity scheduling respects availability, maintenance, material, priority and due dates
Shopfloor transitions and quality hooks remain bounded and auditable
Export uses Scope to Formats to Preflight to Generate to Verify to Package without scope broadening
Readiness joins geometry, manufacturing, routing, nesting, drawing, quality and planning gates
All 25 reference and 6 support surfaces are functional in the real Qt runtime
Dynamic full acceptance is generated from this master traceability
Runtime owned-control scan proves no missing, duplicate, dead or wrong-handler controls
Visual acceptance covers required resolutions and DPI with light primary and dark smoke
Full IFC, STEP, NC1, Trusted PDF and External PDF workflows are tested end to end
Negative file, cache, worker, cancellation, stale-state and capacity paths fail closed
Stress suite proves bounded workspace, selection, camera, save, import/export and optimization behavior
Final Viewer cold/warm/same-session, interaction and resource metrics are packaged evidence
One-folder black-box runtime works without developer Python PATH
Fresh portable black-box runtime works without developer Python PATH
Fresh installer black-box runtime works and preserves file associations
Source zip, git bundle, checksums, SBOM and manifests bind to one exact source SHA
Required FAIL, BLOCKED and NOT_TESTED counts are zero with false green zero
Physical machine transfer remains blocked pending external qualification
Release evidence and binaries are rebuilt after every code change and name the exact SHA
